build_dalle2_decoder: build a DALLE-2 diffusion decoder model using an ADM UNet conditioned on CLIP image embeddings
build_ddpm_sampler: build a DDPM sampler with a cosine beta schedule and noise predictor for image generation
build_cfguidance_wrapper: build a classifier-free guidance wrapper around the ADM UNet model with configurable guidance strength
build_adm_unet: build an ADM UNet diffusion model with configurable depth, channels, and residual blocks
review_dalle2_decoder: review the dalle2_decoder function to understand its ADM UNet construction and DDPM sampling pipeline
